extension.description: XSCleaner keeps your Kodi installation clean and fast. Features include cache cleanup, thumbnail management, database optimization, backup/restore, advanced settings editor, and more.
XSCleaner hält Ihre Kodi-Installation sauber und schnell. Funktionen umfassen Cache-Bereinigung, Thumbnail-Verwaltung, Datenbank-Optimierung, Backup/Restore, Advanced Settings Editor und mehr.
extension.disclaimer: Use at your own risk. Always backup before making changes.
Verwendung auf eigene Gefahr. Erstellen Sie vor Änderungen immer ein Backup.
extension.news: v1.3.5 - Change: Backups are now stored as a single ZIP archive per backup type — no more per-file transfers that can hang on slow or dropped SMB/NFS/FTP shares - New: Restore now downloads and verifies the ZIP, then swaps the restored data in atomically — a failed restore leaves the original data untouched - Fix: All network file operations now run with timeouts and report failures instead of hanging when a share drops mid-transfer - Change: Backup format is now ZIP; older folder-based backups are no longer listed or restorable - Fix: A backup that fails to upload is removed from the share instead of leaving a partial copy behind - Fix: Backups no longer fail when optional files are missing (e.g. advancedsettings.xml) — such items are skipped and logged - Perf: File modification times are preserved in the archive and backup/restore show byte-based progress that can be cancelled - Fix: "Clean ALL thumbnails" no longer reports 0 bytes freed after deleting everything — files inside the Thumbnails subfolders were removed via folder deletion and never counted, so the notification showed "0.0 B" despite hundreds of MB being freed - Fix: Crash log cleanup now also removes Kodi's own crash logs (kodi_crashlog-*.log, kodi_crash.log) from the Kodi home and temp folders — previously only .dmp/.crash dumps in userdata/crashlogs were removed v1.3.4 - New: Backup & Restore now supports network shares (smb://, nfs://, ftp://) - New: Backup folder can be selected via folder browser (local folders, configured sources, SMB/NFS/FTP, manual path) - Fix: Addon logging works again on Kodi 19+ (xbmc.LOGNOTICE was removed in Kodi 19, causing every log call to fail silently) - Fix: Backups copy their contents again — vfs checks on local source folders now fall back to os.path when xbmcvfs stat/exists fails - Fix: Network file copies no longer fail with "utf-8 codec can't decode byte" — binary data (.db/.bak) is now streamed binary-safe (readBytes for network sources, plain binary read for local sources) - Fix: Backups no longer abort with "cannot create directory" on network shares — the created folder is now verified directly (Kodi's mkdirs cache check is unreliable for SMB); file/folder type and size on shares now use the xbmcvfs.Stat class - Perf: Backup and restore can now be cancelled from the progress dialog - Change: Backups no longer include __pycache__ directories and .pyc files — smaller and faster full backups - New: The backup folder can be chosen directly from the addon settings (Backup category) using the same SMB/NFS/FTP folder browser as in the Backup & Restore menu — replaces Kodi's limited native path dialog - Fix: Log Viewer localization strings no longer collide with the new backup/restore strings - Fix: Backup folder browser can return to the top-level overview (drives, sources, SMB/NFS/FTP) from network roots - Fix: Choosing a backup folder on SMB/NFS shares no longer falsely reports "not writable" — the write test now verifies the probe file via a direct stat instead of Kodi's cached directory listing - Fix: The backup folder button in the settings no longer leaves a blank Kodi window — it now runs the browser via RunPlugin and keeps the settings dialog open, returning to it after selection - New: The backup folder browser shows the current folder path in the dialog header (network credentials are hidden) v1.3.3 - Fix: Favorites Manager now correctly locates and parses Kodi's favourites.xml - Fix: Addon leftovers confirmation text now accurately describes what is removed - New: Backup retention keeps only the newest backups per type v1.3.2 - Golden Master / Release v1.3.2b - Fix: Backup restore writes settings and databases back to the correct userdata location - Fix: Fresh Start no longer deletes the XSCleaner addon or its dependencies - Fix: Database orphan cleanup no longer fails with an SQL syntax error (GROUP BY *) - Fix: Celebrity/Artist cache cleanup no longer clears the actorlink table - Fix: Favorites Manager correctly recognizes RunAddon entries and Kodi return parameters - Fix: Orphan artwork cleanup no longer treats image:// and remote URLs as broken - Fix: Auto-update check now parses version suffixes (e.g. 1.3.1b) and is run by the service - Fix: Search history cleanup actually clears recent searches in guisettings.xml - Fix: "Addons + Data" backup now includes addons and addon data (was data only) - Fix: Performance tips now match storage entries correctly in all languages - Fix: Startup Manager parses the JSON-RPC enabled state reliably; Kodi version detection no longer crashes when BuildVersion is unavailable - Fix: Sources check parses sources.xml only once and writes valid UTF-8 XML with proper indentation (Kodi 19 compatible) - Fix: Advanced settings XML is written with UTF-8 declaration, compatible with Python 3.8 - Fix: Crash log subfolders are only removed when they actually contain crash dumps; freed space is now counted correctly - Fix: Log viewer reads only the tail of the log file instead of the whole file - Fix: Dashboard total now shows the actual home folder size - Fix: Auto cleanup is skipped when Kodi shuts down during the startup delay - Perf: Dashboard storage sizes are cached for 10 minutes and invalidated after cleanups - Perf: Thumbnail database rows are deleted in batches of 500 instead of one by one - Perf: Duplicate-row cleanup skips tables with more than 500k rows and logs duration - Perf: Empty-folder cleanup stops early when a pass removed nothing - Cleanup: Removed dead code, unused imports and 53 unused localization strings v1.3.1b - Database optimization now requires a configured backup path - Database backups use the Backup & Restore system format (restorable) v1.3.0b - HTTP/Image, weather, downloads, search history cache cleanup - Celebrity/Artist cache cleanup & Textures13.db rebuild - Favorites Manager & unused language cleanup - Performance tips, system addon protection, remote URL support v1.2.0b - TMDBHelper cache database cleanup - Database Optimize sub-dialog now setting-aware v1.1.0b - Activity logging with audit trail - Version-aware advanced settings editor (Kodi 19-20 vs 21+) - RAM detection for auto-calculated cache values - Settings now actually control menu visibility and execution - Service with interval-based auto cleanup - Cross-platform cache cleanup rewritten - German localization corrected v1.0.0b - Initial release with cache, thumbnails, addons, packages, crash logs cleanup - Database optimization (VACUUM, integrity check) - Advanced Settings editor, Backup/Restore, Fresh Start - Dashboard, Log Viewer, Startup Manager, System Info - Auto cleanup service - German and English language support
